scenarios.label: 1 intermittent API, no database (360 req/day)
scenarios.description: One 256 MB API answering 90 spaced 4-request windows/day (10,800 req/mo), grounded in the measured spread FastAPI trace (7 billed awake seconds per window = 5.25 active hours/mo, 1.353515625 GB-RAM-h).

scenarios.label: 1 business-hours API + Postgres (8 h/day)
scenarios.description: One 512 MB production API serving 8 hours/day (243.33 active hours/mo, 100,000 req/mo) with one small managed PostgreSQL database.

scenarios.label: 5 intermittent services + Postgres (2 h/day each)
scenarios.description: Five 512 MB backend services (public API, webhook receiver, admin API, async worker API, MCP server) each serving 2 hours/day (60.83 active hours/mo per service, 250,000 req/mo total) sharing one managed PostgreSQL database.

scenarios.label: 1 always-on API + Postgres (24/7)
scenarios.description: One 512 MB busy production API running continuously for 730 hours/mo (1,000,000 req/mo) with one small managed PostgreSQL database.
